name: comp-590
title: Team Nav Header
blurb: Icon navbar with team switcher, post button, and status badges.
description: Header with team switcher, icon nav menu, post button, notifications, and user menu. Compact icon layout for content creation apps.
use_when: Content creation or social platforms with team management and quick-publish flows.
avoid_when: Text-heavy navigation; this layout is icon-first.
a11y: Icons have aria-label or sr-only text. Team switcher keyboard-accessible. Post button labeled.
